A particle P of mass 0.2 kg is attached to one end of a light inextensible string of length 0.6 m. The
other end of the string is attached to a fixed point A. The particle P is also attached to one end of a
second light inextensible string of length 0.6 m, the other end of which is attached to a fixed point B
vertically below A. The particle moves in a horizontal circle of radius 0.3 m, which has its centre at
the mid-point of AB, with both strings straight (see diagram).
